title: David and Goliath: Drawing Five Smooth Stones for Success
summary: President Hughes requests that missionaries complete an upcoming departmental survey about their experiences during the quarantine. Introducing a new multi-part series based on the story of David and Goliath from 1 Samuel 17, he draws a parallel between David's choice of five smooth stones over King Saul's unproven armor and the foundational principles he will share for achieving missionary and life success.
